import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Read the data
data = '''survived,pclass,sex,age,sibsp,parch,fare,embarked,class,who,adult_male,deck,embark_town,alive,alone
0,3,male,22.0,1,0,7.25,S,Third,man,True,,Southampton,no,False
1,1,female,38.0,1,0,71.2833,C,First,woman,False,C,Cherbourg,yes,False
1,3,female,26.0,0,0,7.925,S,Third,woman,False,,Southampton,yes,True
1,1,female,35.0,1,0,53.1,S,First,woman,False,C,Southampton,yes,False
0,3,male,35.0,0,0,8.05,S,Third,man,True,,Southampton,no,True'''

from io import StringIO
df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(data))

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Survival Rate by Sex
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
survival_by_sex = df.groupby('sex')['survived'].mean()
survival_by_sex.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1, color=['skyblue', 'lightcoral'])
ax1.set_title('Survival Rate by Sex', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Survival Rate')
ax1.set_xlabel('Sex')
ax1.set_ylim(0, 1)
ax1.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 2. Survival Rate by Class
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
survival_by_class = df.groupby('class')['survived'].mean()
survival_by_class.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax2, color=['gold', 'silver', 'brown'])
ax2.set_title('Survival Rate by Class', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Survival Rate')
ax2.set_xlabel('Class')
ax2.set_ylim(0, 1)
ax2.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 3. Age Distribution
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
ax3.hist(df['age'].dropna(), bins=10, color='teal', alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black')
ax3.set_title('Age Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Age')
ax3.set_ylabel('Frequency')
ax3.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 4. Survival Count
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
df['survived'].value_counts().plot(kind='pie', ax=ax4, autopct='%1.1f%%', 
                                    labels=['Not Survived', 'Survived'],
                                    colors=['lightcoral', 'lightgreen'])
ax4.set_title('Overall Survival', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('')

# 5. Fare Distribution by Class
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
for pclass in df['class'].unique():
    class_data = df[df['class'] == pclass]['fare']
    ax5.scatter([pclass]*len(class_data), class_data, alpha=0.6, s=100, label=pclass)
ax5.set_title('Fare by Class', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_xlabel('Class')
ax5.set_ylabel('Fare')
ax5.legend()
ax5.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 6. Embark Town Distribution
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
df['embark_town'].value_counts().plot(kind='barh', ax=ax6, color='orange', alpha=0.7)
ax6.set_title('Passengers by Embark Town', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_xlabel('Count')
ax6.set_ylabel('Embark Town')
ax6.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

# 7. Survival by Sex and Class (Heatmap-style)
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, :2])
survival_pivot = df.groupby(['sex', 'class'])['survived'].mean().unstack()
sns.heatmap(survival_pivot, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='RdYlGn', ax=ax7, 
            cbar_kws={'label': 'Survival Rate'}, vmin=0, vmax=1)
ax7.set_title('Survival Rate by Sex and Class', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_xlabel('Class')
ax7.set_ylabel('Sex')

# 8. Family Size Effect
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
df['family_size'] = df['sibsp'] + df['parch']
family_survival = df.groupby('family_size')['survived'].mean()
ax8.plot(family_survival.index, family_survival.values, marker='o', linewidth=2, 
         markersize=8, color='purple')
ax8.set_title('Survival Rate by Family Size', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax8.set_xlabel('Family Size (SibSp + Parch)')
ax8.set_ylabel('Survival Rate')
ax8.grid(alpha=0.3)
ax8.set_ylim(0, 1)

plt.suptitle('Titanic Dataset Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
